blockers.blocker_detail: XbrlDocument(path) attempts to fetch XBRL taxonomy from external URL (e.g. https://xbrl.ifrs.org/taxonomy/2021-03-24/ifrs-full). No offline mode found in API. Programmatic creation requires complex custom Context/Unit/Item API with non-obvious constructor signatures. Two repair loops attempted.
blockers.api_evidence: XbrlDocument constructor throws XbrlException: Can't find https://xbrl.ifrs.org/taxonomy/2021-03-24/ifrs-full when loading from file with schemaRef pointing to remote taxonomy. XbrlInstanceCollection.Add() creates instance but Context/Item constructors have complex requirements.
blockers.feasibility: FIXTURE_BLOCKED — requires either (a) offline XBRL taxonomy file or (b) deeper API reverse-engineering
blockers.recommended_wave17_action: Bundle local XBRL taxonomy (US-GAAP or simple custom schema) as file fixture; or use XbrlDocument programmatic creation with fully mapped constructor signatures
